name: Vinus Arcade
description: Pixel art games for the wait between agents, in an office that is yours: your projects hang on the wall, your agents sit at the desks and call you when they need you, and a world ranking crowns the best runs of the week. Blip is the first game; more are on the way. Your projects and agents never leave your computer: only a nickname and your runs do, and only if you join the ranking.

cover.alt: Vinus Arcade: its seven pixel art characters beside a run of Blip, the first game, in an office at dusk.

screenshots.alt: Three views of Blip: the office with agents at its desks before a run, a run with the x2 tile, and a project sent in by an agent that finished.
screenshots.caption: Blip, the first game: your projects on the wall, your agents at the desks, and what they finish flying into your run.

screenshots.alt: A notice from an agent that is waiting, the characters to buy with coins, and the games window with Blip and two games still to come.
screenshots.caption: It tells you when an agent needs you. Coins buy characters, and more games are on the way.

screenshots.alt: The world ranking of Blip: the ten best runs of the week, the card telling a new best and its place on the board, and the way in with a nickname.
screenshots.caption: A world ranking of the week and of all time. Every run is played again on the server before it counts.
